title: GenAI Tools & Enterprise Platform Comparison 2025
description: A practical comparison of ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Perplexity, and adjacent enterprise GenAI platforms in 2025.

articles.title: ChatGPT Enterprise leads on general-purpose versatility
articles.summary: ChatGPT Enterprise is positioned as the most flexible general-purpose assistant thanks to broad reasoning coverage, custom GPTs, and company knowledge workflows.
key_points: ChatGPT Enterprise is strong for multi-department use cases
Custom GPTs and company knowledge patterns improve adaptability
OpenAI was cited as having more than 1M business customers in one 2025 comparison set
Weekly active users were cited as growing from roughly 400M to 800M during 2025
It is strongest where organizations want one broad assistant before fine-grained specialization

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot wins when the workflow already lives in Microsoft
articles.summary: Microsoft Copilot becomes especially compelling inside M365, Teams, Power Platform, and Windows-centric organizations where context and permissions already live in the stack.
key_points: Microsoft 365 Copilot pricing is commonly cited around $30 per user per month
Deep integration with Office and Teams lowers adoption friction in large enterprises
Security, admin controls, and identity integration are major purchase drivers
Barclays was cited as deploying around 100,000 Copilot licenses
Copilot is strongest when the productivity layer itself is the product surface

articles.title: GitHub Copilot is a category leader in developer productivity
articles.summary: GitHub Copilot remains one of the clearest examples of AI product-market fit because it is embedded directly inside a high-frequency workflow: writing and reviewing code.
key_points: GitHub Copilot pricing is commonly cited in the $10-$20 per user per month range depending on plan
Developer adoption was cited around 20M users in one 2025 source set
The product benefits from daily in-editor usage rather than occasional assistant interaction
The strongest value appears in acceleration, suggestions, and context-aware coding help
Copilot succeeds because it reduces friction inside an already digital workflow

articles.title: Perplexity differentiates through live search and citations
articles.summary: Perplexity is best understood as an AI-native research engine rather than a general office copilot. Its core value is current information and transparent citation behavior.
key_points: Perplexity Pro pricing is commonly cited at $20 per month
A June 2025 valuation reference placed Perplexity around $14B
One 2025 source cited roughly 780M search queries in May alone
Source citations and web-grounded answers are its strongest differentiators
It is especially useful for analysts, researchers, marketers, and fast-turnaround knowledge work
articles.use_case: Research stack selection and analyst workflows

articles.title: The real comparison is workflow fit, not feature count
articles.summary: Enterprises often ask which platform is best. The more useful question is: best for which workflow, with which security model, and with what governance expectations?
key_points: ChatGPT is strongest for flexibility and cross-functional ideation
Microsoft Copilot is strongest for Microsoft-native productivity workflows
GitHub Copilot is strongest for engineering productivity
Perplexity is strongest for research and citation-rich exploration
The best enterprise stack often combines multiple tools instead of forcing one universal winner

watchouts: best value depends on Microsoft stack depth
less suited to internal workflow automation
